data.notes: September 2026 already has confirmed highlights across Berlin’s spectrum, from Musikfest’s orchestral program to large-room hip-hop, Latin, indie, and select electronic club nights.

events.title: Musikfest Berlin 2026
events.venueName: Philharmonie Berlin, Haus der Berliner Festspiele, Konzerthaus Berlin, Deutsche Oper Berlin and other venues
events.summary: Berlin’s flagship late-summer classical and contemporary music festival runs from 28 August to 23 September 2026. The announced programme includes major orchestras and ensembles such as the Vienna Philharmonic, London Symphony Orchestra, Le Concert des Nations, Kansas City Symphony and Chineke! Orchestra.

events.title: Sigur Rós — The Orchestral Tour
events.summary: Sigur Rós perform two Berlin orchestral shows at Uber Eats Music Hall on 20 and 21 September 2026. The concerts feature the band with a 41-piece orchestra and choir, including music from ÁTTA and repertoire highlights.

events.title: Baby Keem — The Ca$ino Tour
events.summary: Grammy-winning rapper Baby Keem brings The Ca$ino Tour to Tempodrom on 1 September 2026. The Berlin date is part of the European and UK leg of the tour.

events.title: Else Season Closing x DJ Koze
events.summary: Else’s 2026 season-closing party is headlined by DJ Koze on 19 September 2026. The event is listed as a house-focused all-day programme at the Treptower Park open-air venue.

events.title: Watergate Open Air with Anfisa Letyago, Chez Damier, Isaac Carter & Natalie Robinson
events.summary: A major riverside Watergate open-air session at SAGE pairing contemporary techno force Anfisa Letyago with deep-house pioneer Chez Damier and Berlin/local support across beach and container floors.

events.title: All The Feelings Tour with Metric, Broken Social Scene and Stars
events.summary: Metric, Broken Social Scene and Stars bring the All The Feelings Tour to Columbiahalle on 19 September 2026. The Berlin concert is presented as a major triple-bill for Canadian indie music fans.

events.title: Djavan — 50 years: The Greatest Hits
events.summary: Brazilian singer-songwriter Djavan celebrates 50 years of his career at Tempodrom on 25 September 2026. The programme is billed as a greatest-hits tour dedicated to his classic repertoire.

events.title: Gegen Gear
events.summary: Gegen’s queer, sex-positive KitKatClub takeover returns with a gear/fetish dresscode, multiple performance and harm-reduction elements, and a lineup including fka.m4a, Spikey Lee, Nymed, BOYCA, Buday and Mar/us.

events.title: Rawayana — ¿Dónde Es El After? World Tour
events.summary: Venezuelan band Rawayana play Columbiahalle on 14 September 2026 as part of the ¿Dónde Es El After? World Tour. The promoter highlights the band’s Caribbean rhythms and fusion of funk, reggae, soul, house and rock.

events.title: 23 Jahre Betriebsfeier
events.summary: A 36+ hour anniversary edition of the long-running Berlin Betriebsfeier on the MS Hoppetosse boat, celebrating its 23rd year with techno and house.

events.title: ADAM Berlin — Folsom Europe Official Opening Party
events.summary: ADAM Berlin returns to Metropol as the Folsom Europe official opening party on 10 September 2026. The confirmed lineup includes DJ Hell, Lady Starlight live, Arson Fire, Ruby and Goat Spokesperson.

events.title: BALKANBEATS - Robert Soko DJ-Set
events.summary: Robert Soko brings the legendary BalkanBeats party series to Gretchen, connecting Balkan brass, Eastern European pop, breakbeats, hip-hop and electronica as a Berlin diaspora-club staple.

events.title: Else x OPUS pres. Yanamaste (All Day Long)
events.summary: Else and OPUS present an all-day-long Yanamaste session on 12 September 2026. The open-air-to-indoor event is listed as a techno programme with more artists to be announced.

events.title: Blockhead, ProleteR and Arms and Sleepers
events.summary: Blockhead, ProleteR and Arms and Sleepers play Kantine am Berghain on 25 September 2026. The bill brings together instrumental hip-hop, downtempo and beat-driven live sets.

events.title: MAYHEM x OST
events.summary: MAYHEM brings a hard-edged techno lineup to OST with ALT8, Krl Mx, L.zwo, Maudux, NYRA, SATYS FYRE and YOVA listed.

events.title: SUPA CLUB
events.summary: A two-to-three-floor Berlin party at Spindler & Klatt focused on house, tech house, afro house and electro, listing Noel Holler, Thomas Lizzara, Tube & Berger, Nena Polap, Waikiki and more.

events.title: JONY live at Uber Eats Music Hall
events.summary: Pop singer and songwriter JONY performs at Uber Eats Music Hall on 15 September 2026. The venue describes his music as emotional, R&B-influenced pop with international crossover reach.

events.title: Automatic Noise Berlin
events.summary: Automatic Noise Festival lands in Berlin on 19 September 2026 for its first city edition after six editions in Amsterdam. The confirmed shoegaze lineup features Mahogany, Resplandor, Attic Ocean and Part Garden.

events.title: Birgits WEEKENDER
events.summary: A full weekend-format Birgit & Bier party running from Friday evening into Sunday morning, mixing open-air and clubnight floors across techno and house.

events.title: OPEN AIR DIREKT AM WASSER - FREE
events.summary: A donation/free daytime waterside house and deep-house open air by JYR, with Philippe Autuori, Mad Shivers b2b Hansen, Eloa, Robert Owens and Æ Problæm listed.
